caption: The drawing features a single ornate object positioned centrally on a plain, beige background with no other elements present. The object appears to be a pedestal or candlestick, rendered in shades of gray with fine details emphasizing its three-dimensional form and texture. The base is square with rounded corners and additional rounded supports at each corner. The pedestal rises with a gradual curve, marked by fluted and ribbed decorative patterns. Midway up, there is a rounded section adorned with a series of symmetrical, orb-like protrusions. The top portion is slightly flared with additional horizontal ridges and a flat surface on the uppermost area. A small horizontal scale is placed in the lower-left corner of the page, marked with "0" and "1," possibly for measurement reference.
